Continue the existing goal: faithfully recreate the offline Bubble Tanks 3 game in Bun, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and Pixi. The goal remains incomplete. output.body:
## Summary

Replace the generic summary card and separate Stats tab in standalone, library and in-game creator screens with the authored statistics panel.

```text
avatar → class speed + primary / secondary / passive summaries
enemy → weapon / behavior summaries, five fields18px higher
source raster or mock primitives + source-positioned text fields
```

Reuse the verified artwork/text layers at registration(392,5), export existing primitive/raster helpers without painting changes, and remove the replaced generic markup/styles.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Generic paragraphs show a speed row for enemies and use recreation summary formatting.
  **After:** Source mode-specific labels, class-speed percentages, category ordering/short names/trailing commas and enemy field offsets drive the visible panel.
- Native/mock fixtures verify summaries/passive mount order, 100%→30% class speed, enemy visibility/18px offsets, return-to-avatar state, fixed rendered origin/no scrolling and owned portal/root cleanup. Captures and raw geometry inspected.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 496 tests (6,102 assertions), production build and all ten affected browser cases pass (2.4 minutes, no skips): statistics, real creator controls, library selection/undo, in-game editor cancellation, saved-copy persistence and third-tank medals in both modes. Full native/mock editor captures inspected.
- React layout is render-derived with stable field keys; no effects/listeners/state in the panel. The StrictMode fixture owns its portal host. Existing control clamp/hold/cancel behavior remains verified.
- No original media, schema, simulation or saved-drag-fix changes. Palette layout/full-size previews/advanced enemy statistics and complete Flash timing/pixel comparison remain open; mock font contours/baselines remain approximate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the prior generic summary and Stats tab.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Statistics change across standalone, library and in-game creator entry; their affected native/mock flows pass.
